key.name: theme
key.description: The look of the taskbar, title bars and window buttons, chosen in Patrone Settings: "patrone" (Patrone's own), "modern" (flat and round), "classic" (plain and square, solid title bars), "royal" (Sapphire: glossy sapphire blue, a green Start button) or "studio" (translucent, round colored window buttons). The taskbar follows it; Patrone Settings also puts the theme's style for apps in the account's GTK settings. Where the taskbar's buttons go is the taskbar's own layout setting, which no theme changes.

key.name: title-buttons
key.description: How minimize, maximize and close look in every app: "wide" (flat and wide, close turning red under the pointer), "round" (small symbols in soft circles), "dots" (red, yellow and green dots) or "glossy" (framed blue squares, a red close). "theme" is the theme's own: wide for Patrone and Classic, round for Modern, glossy for Sapphire, dots for Studio. Patrone Settings puts the style in the account's GTK settings. Which corner they go in is GNOME's button-layout.
